newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares close higher on institutional support.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares close higher on institutional support.

text.p: Strong buying by financial institutions coupled with legal respite for former prime minister P.V. Narasimha Rao helped push Delhi shares to a higher close, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index closed 13.35 points higher at 696.97.
"Reports of the bail application of former prime minister P.V. Narasimha Rao being accepted and higher Bombay trends aided the upward trend," said Satish Kapoor of brokers Marwah financial services.
On Wednesday, the Delhi High Court granted Rao pre-emptive, or anticipatory, bail until a lower court holds hearing into a seven-year-old forgery case next Monday.
ITC was in the spotlight and shot up 14.65 rupees to 326.50 as speculators squared positions, brokers said.
ACC spurred 52 rupees to 1,732 on buying by foreign institutional investors (FIIs), they said.
Reliance Industries rose 5.95 rupees to 195.75 on buying by FIIs, brokers said.
TISCO was 3.40 rupees higher at 169, while TELCO gained 15.75 rupees to 410.75 on institutional support.
State Bank of India rose 5.15 rupees to 217.50.
